args.query: WITH per_inspection AS ( SELECT i.slchd_establishment_key, i.inspection_id, i.inspection_date, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN v.violation_code_id END) AS critical_count FROM inspections i LEFT JOIN violations v ON v.inspection_id=i.inspection_id LEFT JOIN violation_codes vc ON vc.violation_code_id=v.violation_code_id WHERE i.inspection_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 years' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ), halves AS ( SELECT slchd_establishment_key, SUM(CASE WHEN inspection_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 years 6 months' THEN critical_count ELSE 0 END) AS earlier_critical, SUM(CASE WHEN inspection_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 years 6 months' THEN critical_count ELSE 0 END) AS recent_critical, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE inspection_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 years 6 months') AS earlier_inspections, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE inspection_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 years 6 months') AS recent_inspections FROM per_inspection GROUP BY 1 ), changes AS ( SELECT h.*, recent_critical-earlier_critical AS change_critical FROM halves h WHERE earlier_inspections > 0 AND recent_inspections > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN change_critical > 0 THEN 'Increased' WHEN change_critical < 0 THEN 'Decreased' ELSE 'No change' END AS direction, COUNT(*) AS restaurants, SUM(earlier_critical) AS earlier_critical_total, SUM(recent_critical) AS recent_critical_total FROM changes GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY direction;
